question: Must going-desire be stated — and who is led guru-ward?
premises: thus speaks: going-desire-ness must be stated, not otherwise, certain
rudra-power-entered is led toward true guru
inference: Going-desire is required; Rudra-entered ones are guru-led.
plain_english: Thus speaks: going-desire-ness must be stated, not otherwise, certain — rudra-power-entered is led toward true guru.
